text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Medium side view: the white car with a visible tan mud line travels across the brown water, drifting left across the five frames with a wake line and spray at its front and rain falling. Windows show seat headrests and no person. Caption unchanged. This is the clearest depiction of a car being carried along water.
